**Is `side` an ancestor of `feat/2.1.327-next`?** No. `git merge-base --is-ancestor side HEAD` exited with 1. The two branches have each committed since they diverged.

**Would merging `side` into it conflict?** Yes. `git merge-tree --write-tree HEAD side` reported `CONFLICT (content): Merge conflict in plans/rebuild/README.md` and exited with 1. Both branches changed line 1 of that file, in different ways.

I did not merge. `git merge-tree` only simulates the merge, so the working tree is clean and nothing was written to the branches.

Both commits are in place:
- `side` has `b10dccb46`, which retitles line 1 to `# claudetto Rebuild Plan (side)`.
- `feat/2.1.327-next` has `678727c0a`, which retitles line 1 to `# claudetto Rebuild Plan (main line)`. It is checked out now.

`git log --all` also lists two older commits, "Retitle rebuild README on starting branch" and "Retitle rebuild README on side branch". They were already in the repo before my changes, and I didn't touch them.
